name: ModelTexture
lead: Pixel art for one face of a box: plain RGBA, and never repainted.

functions.name: pixel
functions.signature: modelTexture:pixel(x: number, y: number, color: Ink)
functions.description: Paints the pixel at x, y; `colors.transparent` makes it see-through.

functions.name: rect
functions.signature: modelTexture:rect(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, color: Ink)
functions.description: Paints a rectangle `w` by `h` pixels from x, y.

title: ModelTexture type
